Open Templates from the side menu and swipe through the styles. Tap a card to start composing in that handwriting.
Type or paste any text into the field. Line breaks and punctuation are preserved as you wrote them.
Tap Generate. HandType lays out your text glyph-by-glyph, varying spacing, rotation and pressure so each note looks naturally hand-written.
From the result screen you can save the note as a PNG to your gallery, save without the paper background as a transparent PNG, share to any app, or export as a multi-page PDF.
Every generated note is automatically archived. Open History from the side menu to revisit, re-export, share or delete past notes.
PNGs and PDFs go to Pictures/HandType in your gallery. On Android 9 and older the app needs storage permission the first time.
What is the transparent PNG for?
It\'s the same handwriting without the paper background, useful when you want to drop the note onto another image, document or slide.
Can a long note span multiple PDF pages?
Yes. The PDF export paginates automatically and snaps page breaks to whitespace between text rows so no character gets clipped.
Why does a glyph look slightly off?
Each character is composed from one of several stored variants and is then rotated, jittered and re-weighted to mimic real handwriting variation.
What does the History screen actually keep?
A private copy of every generated note plus the source text. Nothing is uploaded; deleting an entry removes the on-device copy only.
How does personal handwriting capture work?
You fill out the practice sheet, scan it, and HandType builds a personal template from your handwriting. The capture runs on-device with ML Kit; nothing leaves the phone.
Turn typed text into handwriting that actually feels written. Built-in templates work fully offline; nothing about your text leaves your device.
